findings.title: tests/test_core/test_fit_params_override.py::test_a_hostile_value_is_refused_beside_a_second_spelling_too
findings.detail: WEAK: The docstring claims the hostile value itself causes the refusal, independently of the accompanying alias, but the assertions only check CONFIG_INVALID, a message containing learning_rate, and no training. A duplicate-spelling gate for learning_rate/eta could satisfy all three assertions without rejecting the hostile value at the claimed value-validation gate.
